content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle offer varying levels of functionality for digital product sales. Stripe and PayPal provide comprehensive payment solutions but are limited by geography, leaving many creators unable to use them. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy focus on digital product sales but similarly restrict access in many regions. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, like COREMERCH, provides a complete stack that includes crypto payment processing, automatic delivery, and full data ownership. Creators who choose this architecture benefit from a fully operational online store that doesn't depend on any single payment gateway, giving them true ownership and control over their digital business.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

The conventional platforms avoid countries deemed risky or complicated, effectively excluding millions of creators. Stripe’s limited operational territories mean that vast regions remain locked out of its services, while PayPal's rigid policies can lead to account suspensions that freeze funds for up to 180 days. In comparison, sovereign commerce infrastructure directly addresses these challenges by allowing creators from restricted regions to establish their online stores without being beholden to geographical limitations. With COREMERCH, anyone can deploy their commerce stack and start selling digital products without worrying about account access or suspensions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing speed and fees are crucial factors for digital creators. Traditional platforms often have high transaction fees and can delay payments, especially for creators in restricted countries. For example, PayPal's complex withdrawal processes can add to the wait time. On the other hand, sovereign commerce solutions like NOWPayments enable creators to receive payments instantly with a minimal 0.5% fee, leveraging the efficiency of cryptocurrencies. This not only accelerates cash flow but also reduces the overall cost of sales, making it a more viable option for creators in resource-constrained environments.
Sovereign infrastructure means full ownership, not renting.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

True ownership of your digital commerce stack is non-negotiable for creators. Conventional platforms retain control, meaning creators never fully own their infrastructure or data. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure ensures that once deployed, the creator owns everything outright. This includes automated payment processing and file delivery systems that operate independently of any third-party control. Solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack allow for seamless integration of all necessary components, ensuring that creators can manage their digital products without reliance on intermediaries, thus maintaining complete autonomy over their business.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs and the region you operate in. For creators in restricted countries, opting for a sovereign commerce stack is not just an alternative but a necessity. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a rapid deployment solution that includes critical features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing. This stack allows creators to launch their digital stores immediately, ensuring that they can accept payments and deliver products without the limitations imposed by traditional platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, you can use sovereign commerce infrastructure to sell digital products. Solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack allow you to set up an independent online store with automated crypto payments. This approach provides full ownership and control, avoiding the limitations of traditional payment platforms.
No suspensions or account freezes—true financial autonomy.

This stack empowers creators in restricted countries to establish fully functional online stores without relying on conventional payment systems.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
